messages:
tess (Design): dropping a quick UX thread about the latency panel iteration — attached mock: figma.link/latency-ux. main goals: 1) p95 clarity at small widths, 2) obvious sampling state, 3) heatmap discoverability without dominating the card.

omar (Eng-Frontend): implementation constraints: prefer single-line p95 spark with optional shaded variance only in expanded view. heatmap is expensive; lazy-load behind expand. canvas for heatmap + SVG fallback for a11y.

anya (A11y): accessibility checklist: any metric shown must be reachable via keyboard and have an aria-label. sampling control should announce changes via an aria-live region. heatmap needs a table-mode fallback and a summary text for screen readers.

ravi (Product): copy question: compact card should show a short sampling indicator. Options: "adaptive" vs "auto" vs icon-only. prefer short human language: "Sampling: adaptive (~10%)" on expand, icon-only on compact.

li (Eng-ML): backend will return sample_rate, sample_estimate_range and sample_count. we'll flag low_sample when sample_count < 200 — frontend can show helper: "Low sample 1: p99 may be unreliable." We'll also return sample_type: prefix|uniform|adaptive.

tess (Design): proposed microcopy: compact badge = icon with tooltip "Sampling: adaptive (~10%)"; expanded dropdown label: "Sampling" with microcopy "Adaptive by default. Lower sampling reduces cost but may hide rare spikes." Keep tooltip accessible.

omar (Eng-Frontend): perf notes: throttle hover tooltips, memoize series, virtualize model lists. use existing timepicker component; add a compact preset set: [15m, 1h, 6h, 24h] for quick selects.

anya (A11y): small UI nit: rename "Custom range" to "Choose time range" — clearer for screen readers. ensure the timepicker exposes start/end inputs and supports keyboard entry.

tess (Design): visual proposal: compact row left= p50/p95 spark, center=throughput microbars, right=sampling icon + chevron. expand shows big p95 with optional variance band toggle, heatmap tab, and sampling dropdown. add inline helper when sample_estimate < 5%.

li (Eng-ML): we'll include sample_estimate_min and max so you can show ranges like "~8-12%". also provide sample_window_ms to indicate timeframe used to compute estimates.

ravi (Product): rollout: feature-flagged behind latency_panel_v2. QA with internal SRE first. metrics: expand rate, sampling overrides, and cases where p99 hidden due to low sample.

deploy-bot: preview at https://staging.redwood/preview/latency-panel-ux/1792345678 feature_flag=latency_panel_v2

tess (Design): thanks — action items: anya draft a11y text, omar to stub endpoints and lazy-load heatmap, li to add sample fields to API. will follow up with updated figma link. :thumbsup:
